page.overview:
Who is Amira?

During the day, be found chatting with fellow villager at the water trough next to the . However, she despises others who try to listen in on her conversation and will harshly tell off if he tries to speak with her. If attempts to speak to Nikki instead, Amira admonishes him for trying to eavesdrop. Should make it to the trough before , she will say that she is waiting for someone and ask to leave. To listen to their conversation, must hide out behind the trough. They talk about a who has veen spotted at the . thinks that perhaps the people living in the adopted her, but disagrees.

Like most residents of , will have a reaction if speaks to her while carrying the . She notes that it is dangerous and says that he should not run around with it. If speaks to her again, she scolds him for carrying something so dangerous and tells him to put it away.
